claim: Combine Longer-horizon winners should keep outperforming losers after short-term noise is ignored. WITH Market direction and leadership concentration should matter more than broad diversification.
causal_mechanism: Investor underreaction and slow information diffusion can make 24/52 week relative strength persistent. Combined with: Leadership baskets can compound when market regime supports risk-on participation.
expected_effect: Improve 24/52 week stability versus SPY and parent while avoiding duplicate artifacts.
falsification_rule: Reject if selected universe, trades, or artifacts duplicate parent, or if monthly/yearly SPY comparison does not improve.
